label: Validation rule
description: A rule (RuleSpec, kind validation) that blocks a write unless its assert expression is true, with a message shown on a field. With scope data (the default) it runs on every write path — UI, API, imports, automations, and AI. Optional when limits it to records where a condition holds.
usage: Write the assert as the condition that must hold ("record.title.size() >= 5"), not the error case.
Attach the message to the field the user should fix and phrase it as a fix.
Use scope data for business rules; use scope form only for view-specific checks.
constraints: kind is validation; assert is required and must be a boolean CEL-subset expression over record and user that type-checks against the entity.
message is required; field, when set, must be a field of the entity. Validation rules have no actions.
Expressions are side-effect free with bounded cost; rules run in ascending order, ties broken by ID.
scope form requires view and applies only in that view; it is never a security control.

binding.description: Configuration object in a layer's spec catalog; not a layout node.

examples.description: Ticket titles need at least five characters

spec.message: Use at least 5 characters so agents can triage the ticket.
